Do I need a real estate agent to sell my land to you?
No. You can work with us directly, and agents representing owners are also welcome.
Will you buy a lot with an old house on it?
Yes. Tear-downs and older single-family homes on lots zoned for multiple units are a big part of what we buy.
How do you decide on an offer?
We look at zoning, lot size, how many units can be built, the neighborhood, and recent sales. We'll explain how we got to our number.
Is there any cost or obligation?
No. Submitting your property and getting an offer is free, and you're never obligated to accept.
